title: Part 7
content_zh: Wang Wei painted with words. 'Empty mountain, no one in sight — only the echo of voices.' His poems were landscapes in verse, each character a brushstroke, each line a mountain path leading deeper into the wilderness.
content_en: Wang Wei painted with words. 'Empty mountain, no one in sight — only the echo of voices.' His poems were landscapes in verse, each character a brushstroke, each line a mountain path leading deeper into the wilderness.
